key_expressions: Have you been to the doctor?,

A: You don’t look well. Are you feeling sick?
Maybe it’s because I’ve been tired lately.
But still, I think you should visit a doctor.
B: Yeah, I’ve had a headache since yesterday.
Yeah, headaches get worse when you're tired.
Yeah, I’ll go when I have some time.

A: You’re coughing a lot. Do you have a cold?
Did you take any medicine?
Then drink warm water often.
B: Yeah, my throat is really sore.
I took cold medicine yesterday, but it still hurts.
Yeah, drinking warm water helps a little.

A: My lower back has been hurting lately.
Even sitting down feels uncomfortable.
I guess it might be because I’m not exercising enough.
B: Lower back pain is really tough.
Yeah, if sitting hurts, everything becomes uncomfortable.
How about starting with some light stretching?

A: My stomach hurts today, but I don’t know why.
Maybe it was something I ate this morning.
But I don’t think it’s too serious.
B: Stomach issues can be really uncomfortable.
Did you eat anything cold or heavy?
Yeah, still, eat something light today.

A: I think I have body aches. Everything hurts.
I don’t have any energy at all.
I think I just need a good rest today.
B: Oh no, body aches are really tough.
Yeah, it’s hard to do anything without energy.
Get some sleep. You’ll feel better tomorrow.

A: I’ve been feeling dizzy since this morning.
Maybe it’s because I skipped breakfast.
I should eat something, even just a little.
B: Dizziness can be dangerous.
Yeah, it gets worse if you don’t eat.
Yeah, eat something light. You’ll feel better soon.

A: I haven’t been sleeping well because of stress.
When I lie down, I just keep thinking about things.
Do you know any tips to sleep better?
B: Yeah, lots of people have trouble sleeping lately.
Yeah, when your mind is busy, falling asleep is really hard.
Try drinking warm tea before bed. It helps a bit.

A: I think I have a slight fever.
My body feels hot and I have no energy.
I don’t think I can go to work today.
B: If you have a fever, you should rest well.
Yeah, it’s hard to do anything when your body feels hot.
Rest today and see how you feel tomorrow.

A: My wrist has been hurting a lot lately.
Maybe it’s because I’ve been using the computer too much.
I should stretch more often.
B: Wrist pain makes it hard to work.
Yeah, using it too much definitely causes strain.
Stretching often will help reduce the pain.

A: My stomach feels heavy after lunch.
Maybe it’s because I ate something greasy.
I should eat something easier to digest today.
B: Yeah, greasy food can make your stomach uncomfortable.
Right, it makes the whole afternoon feel heavy.
Eat something light tonight. You’ll feel better.
